title: {staff} did not turn up
text: {staff} missed today without a word, then texts: "car trouble". It is not the first time.
subject: staff

effects.text: {staff} promises it will not happen again.
The team noticed. Nobody liked it.

title: {staff} wants a raise
text: {staff} says other places pay more for the same work — and they are right. They want to be paid fairly.
subject: staff

title: {staff} is resigning
text: {staff} hands you a letter: they are leaving after their notice. Replacing a {role} takes time and money.
subject: staff

else.text: {staff} says thanks, but is still leaving.

effects.text: {staff} packs up and goes. The team is uneasy.

title: Argument in the kitchen
text: {staff} and a colleague are snapping at each other mid-shift. Plates are slowing down.
subject: staff

effects.text: You talk it through. Both cool off.
The bad mood slows everyone in that role for the night.

title: A rival wants {staff}
text: A busy restaurant across town has offered {staff} a job. Good people get noticed.
subject: staff

title: The till looks wrong
text: You notice {staff} slipping a note into their pocket while closing a bill. Or did you?
subject: staff

effects.text: The till keeps coming up short.

title: {staff} is exhausted
text: {staff} looks grey and keeps dropping things. Tired people make mistakes and get hurt.
subject: staff

effects.text: {staff} collapses and is off sick for 5 days.

title: Kitchen injury
text: {staff} cut their hand badly on a knife. Blood, a towel, and a full board of orders.
subject: staff

effects.text: The team sees you look after people.
It gets infected: {staff} is off for 5 days.

title: {staff} asks for training
text: {staff} found a course that would make them better at their job. They are keen.
subject: staff

title: Time off for {festival}?
text: {festival} starts in 3 days. Half the team wants time off to be with family — and it will be packed here.
subject: none

effects.text: Big smiles. About a third will be away.
Wages are doubled for the festival days.

title: {staff} is a star
text: Customers keep asking for {staff} by name. They are good, and they are happy here.
subject: staff

title: {staff} asks for {weekday} off
text: {staff} would like {weekday} as their weekly day off instead. Weekends are your busiest days.
subject: staff

options.label: Agree if they cover a busy day

title: Complaints about {staff}
text: Two people tell you {staff} bullies new staff and spreads gossip. The whole team is on edge.
subject: staff

title: {supplier} is late
text: The {supplier} van has not come. Their driver says tomorrow. Some dishes may sell out today.
subject: supplier

effects.text: Open the Stock tab and order from Cash & Carry (it arrives now, but costs 15% more).
Dishes that run out will be marked sold out.

title: A bad batch from {supplier}
text: Half the delivery from {supplier} smells off. The meat is grey and the herbs are limp.
subject: supplier

effects.text: No charge, but {supplier} is annoyed and you are short today.
Quality of today's food will suffer.

options.label: Use it for staff meals only

effects.text: You pay half; the team eats well.

title: {category} prices are up
text: A bad harvest and fuel costs: {category} will cost 50% more for a week.
subject: category

effects.text: Prices of affected dishes went up 10%.

options.label: Take the costliest off the menu

title: The fridge feels warm
text: The fridge is humming loudly and reads 9°C. Food goes off fast above 5°C.
subject: equipment

title: {supplier} wants paying
text: {supplier} says you owe them money and will only deliver for cash from now on.
subject: supplier

effects.text: No more credit from {supplier} for 8 weeks.

title: Stock is going missing
text: The numbers do not add up: cheese, oil and coffee keep vanishing from the store room.
subject: staff

effects.text: A new lock and a key log.

title: A deal from {supplier}
text: {supplier} likes working with you and offers 8% off for 8 weeks if you order from them every week.
subject: supplier

title: {ingredient} is scarce
text: The season is changing: {ingredient} will be hard to get for a week. Only Premium Provisions still has it.
subject: ingredient

effects.text: Open the Stock tab to order from Premium Provisions.

title: The {equipment} broke down
text: The {equipment} is dead. Without it, some dishes cannot be made. How do you want to fix it?
subject: equipment

effects.text: It stays broken. You can repair it later from the Kitchen tab.

title: The {equipment} just died
text: Mid-service, the {equipment} cuts out with a bang. Orders are piling up.
subject: equipment

options.label: Take its dishes off for tonight

else.text: They could not fix it. It is broken.

title: Power cut!
text: The lights go out across the street. The ovens and the till are dead.
subject: none

effects.text: The generator kicks in. Fuel cost 100.
Only cold dishes for a while.

title: The gas is running out
text: The gas pressure is dropping. Without gas, the hob and ovens stop.
subject: none

effects.text: No hot food for over two hours.

title: A leak under the sink
text: Water is pooling under the dish station. It is getting worse.
subject: none

effects.text: Cleanliness will suffer every day until it is fixed.

title: The leak burst
text: The pipe gave way overnight. The kitchen is under an inch of water.
subject: none

title: Droppings in the store room
text: You find mouse droppings behind the flour sacks. Where there is one mouse…
subject: none

title: The till froze
text: The till screen is stuck on a spinning wheel. Tables are waiting to pay.
subject: equipment

effects.text: Slow bills for the night, and a few mistakes.

title: The landlord wants more rent
text: Your landlord says rents in the area have gone up, and so will yours: +8% from next week.
subject: none

title: A table is getting angry
text: One table has waited a long time for food and is waving at you.
subject: none

title: A guest got sick
text: A customer says they were ill all night after eating here yesterday. They are posting about it.
subject: none

effects.text: It goes public. Rating −0.6, and an inspector is coming.

title: A critic is coming
text: A friend tips you off: a well-known food critic is eating here tonight. Their review counts like ten.
subject: none

title: A party of 12
text: A family wants to book for 12 tonight at 19:00. That is three tables for over an hour.
subject: none

effects.failText: They cancel at the last minute.

effects.text: Deposit paid. They will come at 19:00.
effects.failText: They refuse to pay a deposit and go elsewhere.

title: A bad review is spreading
text: Someone who walked out today wrote a furious review and it is getting shared.
subject: none

title: A rowdy table
text: A loud group is shouting and banging the table. Other customers are looking at you.
subject: none

effects.text: You lose their bill, but the room relaxes.

title: A rival opens nearby
text: A shiny new restaurant opened two doors down with half-price opening offers.
subject: none

effects.text: Discounts cost you about half a day's sales over two weeks, but customers stay.

title: The health inspector
text: A health inspector is at the door with a clipboard. They check the kitchen, the fridge and the toilets.
subject: none

title: You are out of money
text: Your bank balance is below zero. Three days like this and the bank closes you down. What now?
subject: none

effects.text: A private lender covers you, at triple interest.
30,000 now; they take 20% of every profitable week, forever.

title: A tax audit
text: The tax office wants to check your books for the last year.
subject: none

title: Your licence is overdue
text: A letter from the council: the trading licence the last owner should have renewed is overdue.
subject: none

options.label: Pay now with the late fee

title: Fined for the licence
text: The council caught up with you: a 3,000 fine and a day's closure until the licence is sorted.
subject: none

title: A film crew wants your room
text: A film crew wants to shoot in your dining room this morning. They pay well, but you will open an hour late.
subject: none

effects.text: You open an hour late today.

title: A pizza challenge
text: A local radio host challenges you to a live pizza-making contest outside the restaurant this evening.
subject: none

effects.text: You win the crowd: busier for three days.
effects.failText: You lose, but people had fun.

title: Truffles at a bargain
text: A forager offers a basket of truffles at half price. A truffle special could make a splash — or go off unsold.
subject: none

effects.text: The special sells out and people talk about it.
effects.failText: Few order it; most goes to waste.

title: A nonna in the kitchen
text: An old regular says your sauce "is not how it was". She offers to show your cooks her recipe — for free.
subject: none

title: The wok burner roars
text: Your head chef wants to turn the wok burners up for real "wok hei" — smokier, faster, harder on the equipment.
subject: none

effects.text: Dishes taste better; the woks will wear faster.

title: A dumpling order for an office
text: A nearby office wants 400 dumplings for a party tomorrow. Good money, but it will tie up your kitchen this morning.
subject: none

title: A tea merchant visits
text: A tea merchant offers fine jasmine tea for your guests. Customers notice the little things.
subject: none

title: Musicians at the door
text: A mariachi band offers to play on Friday night for tips and a meal.
subject: none

title: Avocado prices crash
text: A glut in the market: avocados are cheap this week. A guacamole special?
subject: none

title: A salsa contest
text: The street fair has a salsa-tasting contest. Entering costs a morning of prep.
subject: none

effects.text: You win! The trophy goes in the window.

title: The tandoor will not heat
text: The tandoor is struggling to reach temperature this morning.
subject: none

effects.text: No naan or tandoori for the first two hours.

title: A spice merchant
text: A spice merchant offers freshly ground garam masala. Better spices, better curries.
subject: none

title: A wedding party
text: A family asks you to cater a small wedding lunch tomorrow at their home.
subject: none

title: {outlet} is failing
text: Eight losing weeks in a row. The staff know it, the regulars know it. Rescue it, close it, or let it drift?
subject: none

options.label: Rescue plan: be there 4 of 7 days

effects.text: You promise to be there. The team takes heart.
Two staff start looking for other jobs.
